body.name: A_id_ell_R
body.def: \(\mathfrak A^{\mathrm{id}}_{\ell,R}\) is the finite ordered set of chart records \(\chi\) for which \(\mathcal U_{\chi}\cap\mathcal O_{\ell,R}\ne\varnothing\) and \(g_{\chi}(\Phi_{\ell,R}(\theta))=\beta(\theta)\) for every \(\theta\in\Theta_{\ell,R}\) with \(\Phi_{\ell,R}(\theta)\in\mathcal U_{\chi}\); the set itself is total and may be empty.
